text:
talia: kicking off GlacierPay LoRA onboarding. pushed quick-eval pack to staging (job 7722). dataset = invoice lines + percent discounts + currency symbols. expect odd token merges around % and currency codes.
omar: plan: fp16 -> int8 -> int4. capture QA_F1, exact_match, amount_tolerance, avg_latency. ETA ~2h.
vikram: uploaded focused probe set /evals/glacierpay/money-percent-probes.json (35 examples) including patterns like '5.00%', 'USD 1,200', '€(1,234)'. flagged on job.
zoe: fp16 baseline local: QA_F1=0.871, exact_match=0.73, amount_tolerance=0.989, latency=69ms. snippet: ```json
{"job":"7722","phase":"fp16","metrics":{"qa_f1":0.871,"exact_match":0.73,"amount_tolerance":0.989,"avg_latency_ms":69}}
```
omar: int8 staging results: QA_F1=0.862, exact_match=0.71, amount_tolerance=0.965, avg_latency=54ms. probe fails 6/35 (percent signs and thousands separators).
vikram: example fail: source 'Discount: 12.5%' -> model returned '12.5 %' (space before %). our exact_match flagged it. seems like token emission spacing changes after quant.
talia: interesting. we've seen comma-removal issues before; percent-space is a new variant. propose scoring-only canonicalizer that normalizes spacing around %, currency codes, and strips interior commas for numerics. low-risk and keeps model outputs unchanged.
zoe: agree. also add failing-tokenid dumps for all probe failures to s3://redwood-debug/glacierpay/7722/fails.log so we can inspect decode ids.
ci-bot: staging job 7722 -> int4 run queued on node gpu-small-11 (ETA 11m).
omar: I'll implement canonicalizer and rerun. PR outline: add normalize_money(text) to eval comparator; regex examples: `re.sub(r"(?<=\d)\s+%", "%", text)` and `re.sub(r"(?<=\d)[,](?=\d)", "", text)`. pushing branch `glacier/normalize-money`.
vikram: I'll run token-diff tool afterwards: `python tools/token_diff.py --model glacierpay --quant int4 --samples probe_ids.txt` and put outputs in the ticket.
zoe: after canonicalizer patch in harness: int8 QA_F1=0.865, probe fails 2/35 (mostly parentheses and negative amounts). int4 QA_F1=0.833, probe fails 5/35. canonicalizer removed most percent/space issues.
talia: decision proposal: int8 default for canary, int4 behind experimental flag. emit token-dumps for failing probes. owners: omar -> quant runs & PR, vikram -> token diffs, zoe -> probe curation & metrics, talia -> rollout note + rollback steps. :memo:
ops-bot: canary rule added: block promotion if amount_tolerance drop >1.2% vs baseline on probe set. alerting to #eng-oncall.
vikram: saved failing int4 token ids to s3://redwood-debug/glacierpay/7722/int4-tokenids.log and uploaded token-diff outputs to the ticket. early sign: int4 decoder sometimes emits '%' as separate token with leading space in decoding sequence.
omar: small UX ask: add a smoke repro command for engineers: ```bash
# repro spacing around percent sign in int4
python tools/smoke_repro.py --sample 9 --model glacierpay --quant int4
```
zoe: running a quick shadow on production-like traffic with int4 behind flag and the canonicalizer in scoring only. will report telemetry after 4h.
talia: wrap-up: merge canonicalizer PR, run canary int8 tonight, keep int4 shadow. follow-up task: investigate whether decoder bias table in int4 causes token emission spacing shifts (assign to infra/research). if canary breaches canary rule, rollback to fp16. thanks team :rocket:
